title: X (Twitter) Profile Scraper & Growth Monitor
description: Extract public X profiles and recent posts, then track follower, posting, verification, and profile changes across scheduled runs. No X login or API key required for public-page mode.

usernames.title: X usernames or profile URLs
usernames.description: Up to 25 public X accounts. Enter usernames such as openai or full x.com/twitter.com profile URLs. Duplicates are removed.

maxTweetsPerProfile.title: Recent posts per profile
maxTweetsPerProfile.description: Recent original posts to include inside each profile row. Public-page mode supports up to 20; official API mode supports up to 100. Set 0 for profile metrics only.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Include recent posts identified as replies.

includeRetweets.title: Include reposts
includeRetweets.description: Include recent posts identified as reposts.

trackGrowth.title: Track growth and changes
trackGrowth.description: Compare this run with the previous matching monitor run. Adds follower growth, posting pace, changed fields, and actionable signals.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Stable name for this watchlist, for example US AI competitors. Use the same name on scheduled runs to preserve its comparison history.

observationHistoryLimit.title: Saved observations per profile
observationHistoryLimit.description: Number of recent observations retained for each profile in this monitor. History is bounded to control storage.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: Auto uses your official X API token when supplied; otherwise it reads the public profile page without login. Choose API to require official API data.
enumTitles: Auto — public page unless API token is supplied
Public page — no login or API key
Official X API — bring your own token

xApiBearerToken.title: Official X API bearer token
xApiBearerToken.description: Optional secret token from your X developer account. It is never saved in results or logs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional fallback for public-page requests. Direct access is tried first to control cost; a configured proxy is used only for one retry after direct access fails.
